tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (503)༄༅/ /bstan srung ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dpal chen rgwa lo nas brgyud pa'i thel lugs dang tshal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas
(503)༄༅/ /bstan srung ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dpal chen rgwa lo nas brgyud pa'i thel lugs dang tshal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (503)༄༅// bstan srung ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dpal chen rgwa lo nas brgyud pa'i thel lugs dang tshal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

(504)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ ma nor lam ston bla ma dang*// yi dam lha dang bstan srung ni// dngos grub ster ba la btud nas// sgrub thabs lag len bri bar bya/ /dpal nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa sgrub par 'dod na/ yi dam gyi mngon rtogs sngon du 'gro bas/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ bstan pa srung ba'i phyir du nag po chen po bsgrub snyam du sems bskyed/ bla ma dang yi dam chos skyong dang bcas pa tshogs zhing gi tshul du spyan drangs yan lag bdun pa bya/ rgyun gyi gtor chog la de rnams mi dgos/ gang ltar yang mchod gtor legs par bshams la/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa wang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsangs gtor/ me tog /bdug (505)spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ pāt+yaṃ/ āñca ma naṃ/ pro k+ṣa ni/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+da/ oṃ badz+ra ghāṇ+ḍa ra ṇi ta sogs kyis byin dbab/ rten yod na de nyid bskyed dgos shing*/ med na gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bskyed pa yin te/ de yang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā ཿswa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur khang me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang*/ rang gi mdun du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang bcas shing*/ ro dang ro langs dang srin po dang (506)'byung po dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su sa gzhi la rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/

dbus su thod pa 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang zlum po/ steng keng rus kyis phub pa/ phyi nang kun tu rin po che dang*/ lha rdzas kyi gos dang*/ me tog dang*/ zhing lpags nang khrol rus phreng dang skra'i rnga yab la sogs pa phrin las rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du gyur/ 'di'i las thams cad pa'i gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul rgyas pa yin la/ las re re la las dang mthun pa'i khang pa so so dang*/ bsdu na rgyun 'don la yang dur khrod kyi gzhi kho nas chog pa yin no/ /rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba zhig 'phros te gdan steng du 'khod/ hūm̐ de nyid kyi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad de gnas sbar/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la dpa' bo chen po sku mdog mthing nag du sa mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril zhing*/ ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi gad rgyangs sgrogs pa/ sma ra/ smin ma/ dbu skra ser po me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos ka pā la khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ yang na/ g.yas dang pos be ta'i 'bras bu snying dang 'dra ba bzung bar byas kyang rung ngo*/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin (507)cing*/ g.yon 'og mas tri shū las mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dar dpyangs dang bcas pa phyar stabs su bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rtse bran dang*/

sbrul rigs bzhi dang rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan la dpa' bo rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir yi ge gsar pa 'ga' na trī shū la kho na yod pa dang*/ yig rnying phal cher na/ phyag mtshan tri shū la'i dod du rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod cing*/ rus rgyan ma bshad pa ltar yang rung ngo*/ de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ gsum spros te/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon dang mdun gyi grar 'khod pa ni/ las kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag /khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mi'u thung gi rnam pa can rdo rje gnam lcags kyi mchu dang ldan pa'i bya rog gi gdong khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing zhal du rngub pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyi dor stabs can/ dug sbrul nag pos brgyan cing*/ skra mtshams nas rdo rje bya khyung spro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can gsum du gyur// gtso bo'i g.yas su k+ṣa las legs ldan nag po/ phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi beng chen dang*/ g.yon pas lcags kyi par bu bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber can/ zhabs la sag l+h+wam yu ring gsol zhing*/ g.yon brkyang ba/ gser gyi ska rags can/ gtso bo'i g.yon du bh+yo las tsaṇ+ḍi kā dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag /g.yon gnyis mi mgo dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ gcer bu khro zhing sgeg pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas bskum (508)g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du hūm̐ las sha za nag mo seng ge'i gdong pa can ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can dar nag gi na bzas dkris pa'o/ yang g.yas su bya rog gdong can gcig /g.yon du lha mo/ mdun du seng gdong*/ rgyab tu beng ma 'god ba'i lugs dang*/

beng ma dang bya rog gdong rgyud gcig pas bing mi 'god pa yang shin tu mngag par ltar yang rung ngo*/ de'i phyi rol sgo mtshams brgyad du yi ge ma brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma bya rgod kyi gdong pa can// byang du khyung gi gdong pa can/ nub tu khwa ta'i gdong pa can/ lhor 'ug pa'i gdong = shar lhor phag gi= lho nub tu khyi'i= nub byang du spyang ki'i= byang shar du stag gi gdong pa can/ brgyad ka'ang gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i stang stabs sna tshogs pas gnas pa/ 'khor de thams cad kyang dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ mi ro'i gdan la rnam par 'gying ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ de'i phyi rol du nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min dang dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ na len+d+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la'i tshogs// bdag gis thugs dam gnyan bskang na// dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ mgon po'i spyi bor (509)'khor lo la oṃ dkar po// mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po// thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po// yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/

oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /mthu stobs dang nus mthu la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ ye shes mgon po la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes la byed pa'i dbang ltar byas nas/ rigs bdag bde mchog lhan skyes kyis byed pa man ngag tu 'dod ba'ang snang mod kyi/ man ngag khung ma rnams nas gong bzhin bshad cing*/ 'di kho na 'thad pa yin no/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ āñca mā naṃ/ pro k+ṣa naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod dang*/ hūm̐ gzi brjid sku yis srid gsum zil gyis gnon// gsung gi bzhad sgras sde brgyad bran du bkol// brtse ba'i thugs kyis 'gro drug dbang du sdud// lha chen dpal 'bar nag po khyod la bstod// bka' yi pho nya nag po'i gtso// bya rog gdong can 'jigs pa'i gzugs// khros pa'i cha lugs rngam pa'i zhal/ dam nyams srog gcod khyod la 'dud// srin po'i tshogs la mnga' bsgyur zhing*// khams gsum srog bdag chen po ni// bdud 'dul tsan+dan beng chen bsnams// thugs kyi sprul pa khyod la 'dud// dpal ldan lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kā /lha (510)min mu stegs tshogs 'joms shing*// nad kyi bdag mo drag shul can// srog la dbang bsgyur khyod la bstod// bsil ba'i tshal gyi shing gcig drung*// nag po chen po seng ge'i gdong*// zhing skyong sha za chen po ste// dpal gyi bka' sdod khyod la bstod// gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chen po brgyad// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba sde brgyad bcas// kun la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/

rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod cing*// dam la gzhag gtor chog tsam gyi skabs yin na// bstod pa brgyad pa lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bton la// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba la 'jug pa yin cing*// bzlas brjod byed bar 'dod na skabs 'dir bzlas pa byas la// de nas bstod pa byas te gtor ma 'bul ba yin no// de la bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nye snying dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces khyad par gyi snying po dang*/ shā sa na rtsa ba'i sngags yin la/ oṃ karma ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las mgon gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo las mgon sbrag pa'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā ka mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ las mgon gyi mtshan sngags dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la k+ṣi pheṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ legs ldan beng gi sngags dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā li de wī wāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā du tri phu tri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sha za seng ge'i gdong gi sngags so// dregs pa thams cad kyi thun mong gi sngags ni// gzhi snying du grags pa yin te// man ngag gi yi ge rnams su shes par bya'o// de nas da lta rkang brgyad du grags pa zhing skyong gi sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa ste// bstod pa brgyad pas bstod par bya ste/ de yang*/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// hā hā hūm̐ yig sgra dang ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs ro langs 'byung pos bskor// hūm̐ hūm̐ mdzad cing kun nas mi shes (511)zhal dang rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'khrug pa'i sku// phyag na mdung dang kha ṭāṃ mi thod 'dzin pa 'dod pa'i gzugs can mi sdug gzugs/

spyan ni ser zhing skra ser ro yi 'du sa la dgyes zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs// zhal nas pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ yig sgra dang so sor bskyod pa'i me chen mchog gi dbus// rab gsal 'jigs pa'i sku dang yan lag mgo phreng nye bar mdzes pas rgyan du mdzad// bsad pa'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag dum bu drag po'i phyag gis 'dzin cing mchod yon 'thung*// mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod ni rol zhing rol pa'i rtse mos srungs// k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ dang ca co sgrog mdzad bzod pas gdug can rnams 'ching bzod pa'i sku// char sprin sngo mdog ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad gcig pus sna tshogs gnon cing gnon// k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ shriṃ sngags sku can pa tsa pa tsa sreg mdzad kun nas sngags kyi rigs// sgrub pa rnams kyi bgegs rnams skrod cig nges par zhi bar mdzod cig zhing skyong kye// hā hā hār bzhad gad rgyang phul byung phyugs rnams dus kun 'jigs par mdzad pa gang*// 'jig rten rnams kyi bgegs 'joms nyin rer dri med rab thob rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra skad drag po'i nus mthus srid pa gsum khongs gang bar 'gengs// srung shig zhing skyong smar ral pa dbu skra khams ser ldan pas nye bar sgrubs// khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ 'gying sgeg rol lto ba 'phyang ba phyag na ral gri khrag 'thung ba// raṃ raṃ raṃ ni spyan dmar gtum shugs phyag gi ru ru'i khrag la spyod par mdzad// kruṃ kruṃ kruṃ khros lta stangs mdzod cig ma lus bdud rnams 'khums pa'i khro gnyer mdzod// ḍaṃ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ 'dis 'dul mdzad cang te'u ldan pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis bsrung bar mdzod// kraṃ kraṃ kraṃ mdzad bdud dang dgra bo nyon mongs bag chags ma lus nges par 'joms// kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ gi sku ni nag po'i mchu mtshungs rtsod dang nyes 'grog thod phreng can// tsaṃ tsaṃ tsaṃ cher rab (512)g.yo rmad byung sa gzhi 'jig rten snang byed gtum po'i shugs// saṃ saṃ saṃ bdag dge 'dun dam tshig dge bar spyod pa zhing skyong khyod kyis srung*// yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ 'gro sna tshogs dri med chu bzhin gzigs nas nges par gshin rje 'gog

/baṃ baṃ baṃ ni 'jig rten rab spyod skad cig rlung shugs glog ltar rab tu mkhyen// bhūṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ 'jig khro gnyer mchog mdzad sgrub po rnams la 'jigs pa las grol ste// k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ ni gnod pa ring du skad cig la zad bde mdzad zhing skyong kye// klaṃ klaṃ klaṃ gang rul ba'i lus can srid gsum 'gro ba dus kun nyon mongs rnams// baṃ baṃ baṃ mdzad phyag gi zhags pas phyugs rnams 'dzin cing gdul bya rnams skyong ba// sngags bdag sngags kyi lus can zhi bde'i 'bras ster sngags pa rnams la sngags dang mtshungs// zhing rnams skyong ba khyod kyis lus can skye bo mtha' dag gang 'dir yun ring skyongs// sngags rnams brgyad po thun gsum du ni klog byed nges pa mkhas pa'i blo can gang*// slob dpon dang ni sgrub po'ang dam tshig dge ba spyod rnams rgyal 'gyur bsod nams ldan// tshe dang dpal dang grags dang 'byor ldan mnyam med stobs 'dzin rnam gnon 'od rgyas te/ de yis bgegs tshogs nyams shing mtshungs med thams cad shes pa nyin mtshan rtag tu ster/

zhes pa'o/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lngas/ thod pa'i steng du zla ba'i kha gcod hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa'i rdo rjes brgyan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa rnams mgo bo thur bstan/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'dres/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru (513)gsum las 'od 'phros/ gtor ma'i steng gi 'bru gsum la phog /mas rim gyis gtor ma la thim pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi sngo dmar dkar po'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rdo rjes bdud rtsi lan gsum du dkrugs// rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje yang zhu zhing 'dres pa las/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ 'di ni 'di nyid kyi man ngag las 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i lugs yin la/ yi dam gang byed de'i cho ga las 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs de nyid kyis kyang nges par rung ngo*/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i spu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis gtso bo dang 'khor rnams la spro na/ snying po lan gsum gyis 'bul zhing*/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thun mong du/ rtsa sngags kyis 'bul ba ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi e ṣo3 pash+tsi ma/ kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇa/ ya di pra ti dz+nyā/

sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da na da na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum mo/ 'di ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'bring po ltar na/ shā sa na gcig pus chog /bsdus pa ltar na/ gtso bo'i gtor sngags thung ngu des kyang chog go /gtor chog kho na'i skabs/ de rjes 'dod don gsol btab la 'jug /bsnyen pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ slar yang ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ gong bzhin bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs sam/ rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan (514)bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ sems can la bde skyid kyi dpal rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bsam sbyor phun tshogs chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad pa la sogs pa phrin las rnam pa bzhi g.yel ba med par mdzad du gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ āt+ma ka tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ smon lam btab cing bkra shis bya'o/ yum tsaṇ+ḍi kā nag mor byed na/ gong du bshad pa'i dmar mo rtsa 'jibs ma dang sku mdog ni khyad par ma gtog 'dra la/ de nyid bong zhon ma dang*/ dre'u zhon mar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ lo ka shrī'i lugs kyi 'dod khams ma'am/ dud sol ma grags pa dang*/ re ma ti bong zhon ma dang*/ dre'u zhon ma ci rigs pa dag lcam dral du byed pa'i lugs kyang 'dug mod/

spyir de ltar sbyor ba mi 'gal yang*/ 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa yod bzhin du gzhan du bsre bar mi bya'o// dpal chen po rgwa los 'gro mgon tshal pa la gnang ba'i lugs ltar na/ sku gsung thugs kyi bya rog gdong can gsum gtso bo'i mdun du bzhugs pa dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du seng gdong gsum dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā gsum/ gtso bo'i g.yon du lha mo re ma tī ral gri dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ de'i mdun du e ka dzā ṭi dmar nag phyag bzhi pa rtse gsum mi snying thod rlon lcags spyang khra thogs kyi tshul can du bskyed nas/ lha mo la sngags/ ma ma tra ka ru tra mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ /ces bzla ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad po'ang sku mdog dmar mor mdzad pa ni khyad par ro// 'di nyid kyi bstod pa dang*/ mchod phreng dang*/ thugs dam bskul ba la sogs pa rgyas par spro na yig rnying rnams las shes par bya la/ sgrub thabs kyi ngo bo 'di kho nas chog shes par bya zhing*/ khrid tshul zab (515)mo ni logs su bzhugs pa ltar nyams su blang par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ phyag len lugs gnyis las/ dang po dpal phag mo gru pa las brgyud pa ni shom bya tshul dkyil 'khor sgom don dang mthun pa'am/ bsdu na zlum skor gyi nang du/ gru gsum mthing nag lha grangs mnyam pa'i tshom bu can dbus su gtor ma snying gzugs ma mañji la bkod/ mthar 'bul gtor lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang 'os dang*/ bdud rtsi'i thod pa/ nang mchod sogs dang mchod pa rnams bsham/ shin tu bsdu na/ dkyil 'khor med kyang chog pas/ dpal gyi gtor ma la brten pa kho nas kyang rung ngo*/ gtor 'bul yan chad gong du bstan pa bzhin byas la/ slob ma rnams la phyi rol du khrus chab btang*/ nad du 'khod/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab/ spro na sngon 'gro'i chos bshad ci rigs byas la/ 'dir skabs su babs pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa 'di nyid nges pa'i don tu bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa dang dbyer med pa ste/

rgyud las/ dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi// gsang gsum las sprul nag po che/ zhes gsungs shing*/ 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud ni bcom ldan 'das shākya seṅges shrī dha n+ya ka ṭa kar gsang ba sngags kyi chos kyi sde chen po gsungs ba'i tshe/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i chos sde chen po zhig gsungs pa'i snying po bka' bsdu ba dang 'dzin pa'i paṇa grub rnams kyis phyung ba dpal mgon po sgrub pa'i thabs dbang rgyud man ngag gi chos skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod cing*/ rgya gar du'ang slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras dang*/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs kyang bstan srung gi gtso bor mdzad/ rgyud 'grel man ngag ci rigs pa bod du spyan 'dren pa po lo tsā ba ci rigs byung ba'i nang nas/ 'dir dpal rgwa lo tsā ba he ru ka dang rnam dbyer med pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pa de'i lugs rtsa bar bzung*/ de la slob ma zhang tshal pa/ phag grub/ (516)gsal stong pa/ a seng*/ cog ro sogs mang yang thel tshal gyi lugs mchog tu bsngags pa de yin/ de la rjes gnang gi sgo mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa las/ 'dir phag gru lugs kyi rjes gnang sgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod ba dang*// log 'dren bgegs rnams tshar gcod phyir// mgon po'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma dang ye shes mgon po'i dkyil 'khor rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon tu 'gro bas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum/ rjes su gnang ba dngos gzhi'i thog mar dmigs pa 'di bzhin du bsgom mdzod/

bla ma he ru ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po thog lhung ba ltar byung ste/ slob ma'i lus la g.yon bskor lan gsum byas nas spyi bor thim pas ma dag pa'i lus sbyangs te/ 'od zer mthing kha'i phung po chen por gyur/ de las dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su/ pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mgon po'i skur gsal btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bsil ba tshal/ na len+d+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/ ye shes pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'ur 'ur chem chem gyi sgra dang bcas ste byon/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ sngags drag tu bzla/ de nas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i (517) bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang bas dbang bskur la/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /mthu stobs dang nus mthu la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par mos shig /de ni sku'i rjes gnang sku'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/ de nas slob dpon la mos gus byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po'i thugs kar phog /thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'phros/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas brgyud de thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar 'khod/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/

snying ga'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig /yi ge bcu pa dang*/ shā sa na 'i rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug /dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par bya ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin tu 'di'i rjes zlos// bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ ces lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang gi spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ sngags kyi dngos grub (518)stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la/ rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang bsil ba tshal la sogs pa nas/ sngags kyi yig 'bru dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags phreng la bstim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam la/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang gsung gi byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/ bla ma yi dam mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros rang lus la thim/ lus yas mas nas rim pas zhu ste snying ga'i sngags 'khor la thim/ de hūm̐ la/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ nā da yang mi snang bar gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag /yang hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sgras/ slob ma mgon po'i skur skad cig gis gsal btab/ slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ bsil ba tshal la sogs pa nas/

thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi phyag mtshan so so dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba la sogs pa'i las mdzad/ slob ma'i snying khar thim pas/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam la/ rol mo'i sgra byas// thugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs 'bebs pa'o/ phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ni/ gtor ma dpal 'bar can slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzung la/ gtor snod dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang du/ gtor ma ye shes mgon po nag (519)po chen po 'khor g.yog pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du slob dpon dang 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa gsal btab/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba bsgom du bcug /bla ma yi dam gyi tshogs kyis chos skyong srung ma rnams la bka' bsgos pas/ de rnams kyis rdo rje'i bro drag po 'khrab pas/ dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag par mos pa gyis/ zhes brjod la/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te/ bstod pa brgyad pa tshar gcig dang shā sa na dang sngags rnams tshar gcig drag tu brjod pa'i rjes la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa lcam dral/ bran g.yog bka' sdod pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ā r+ya de ba/ slob dpon rta dbyangs/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ā bha ya ka ra/ tsā mi sangs rgyas grags/ rgwa lo gzhon nu dpal/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la sogs pa rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig gi rim pa las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung*/ sems can gyi bde skyid spel/ bye brag tu rig pa 'dzin pa'am rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad las srungs shig

/mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sol cig /mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs shig /spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bye brag rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /mdor na rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i chos ldan bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ mthar bla ma rnams (520)yi dam la thim/ de rnams mgon po 'khor bcas la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas slob ma thim pa dpon slob gnyis cer gyis bsgom/ bkra shis kyi tshig bcad ci rigs par brjod/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o// gtor dbang kho na byed par 'dod na// gsol btab rgyun bshags song ba'i rjes la/ slob ma'i blo'i dor/ gtor ma mgon por bskyed cing spyan drangs/ de nas gong bzhin gtor ma'i bka' bsgo nyid byas pas kyang bar chad sel ba'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur zhing*/ mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs la dbang ba yin no// yang chos skyong du mi brten par bar chad sel ba tsam don du gnyer ba la/ bka' bsgo'i skabs srung ma mdzod ces pa bor/ mgon po slob ma la bstim pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos// rjes gnang 'di bka' yangs shos de yin na'ang*/ byin rlabs kyi babs shin tu che zhing zab pa yin no// bum dbang bcu bzhi par grags pa zab mor bzhed cing*/ phyag len bka' dogs por mdzad pa de ni/ dbang chog rin chen phreng ba las shes par bya la/ dbang bzhi rdzogs su grags pa 'ga' zhig ni/ byin rlabs kyi sgo cung zad yod srid na'ang*/ khungs dang ldan pa ma yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag par bya'o// gnyis pa tshal lugs kyi phyag len ni/ dkyil 'khor sgo med lha rnams phyogs mdog can gyi dbus su/ pad+ma sngon po 'dab brgyad lte ba dmar po la chos 'byung nag po zhig 'bri/ 'dab ma brgyad la tshom bu dmar po brgyad dgod/

chos 'byung la gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig 'bri/ de'i steng du mañjil bum pa/ rgyab tu dpal bshos snying gzugs mda' dar gyis brgyan pa/ mdun du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor ma/ g.yas su ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon du dam tshig gi rdo rje rnams bzhugs/ bdag mdun gnyis song ba'i rjes su/

gtor ma bum pa/ thod pa/ rdo rje rnams la// mgon po lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba bde mchog lhan skyes kyi dbu rgyan can re bskyed/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba buṃ b+dha badz+ra ḍā ki nī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum sbrel gang nas zhig bzla/ slob ma'i bya ba chos bshad skabs/ tshal lugs kyi rjes su gnang ba zhes bsgyur/ gzhan rnams cung zad 'don pa spong ma gtogs/ sku'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa yan chad dgong du bshad (521)pa dang 'dra ba las/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur skabs dbang lha spyan 'dren mi dgos/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen pos rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ri bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas spyi bo'i 'khor lo gang*/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gang*/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga'i 'khor lo gang*/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lte ba'i 'khor lo gang*/ sgo gsum cha snyoms kyi sgrib pa dag /dbang bzhi pa thob par mos shig /gong gi sngags gsum sbrel gyi mthar/ a bhi ṣiñca btags ste bum pas dbang bskur/ de nas gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba la/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas// sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ bdud rtsi'i dbang ni/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag la/ gong ma'i tshig la 'don pa spos te/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i= /gsung gi= /ngag gi= /gsung mi 'gyur nus mthu'i dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la wā ka a= /rdo rje'i dbang ni/ rdo rje snying khar bzung la/ stong nyid rdo rje'i= /thugs kyi= /yid kyi= /thugs mi 'gyur 'od gsal dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la tsit+ta=

hūm̐/ yon tan phyag mtshan gyi dbang ni/ /ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi// be ta'i 'bras bu'i dbang bskur bas// rin chen gter gyi char pa 'bebs// longs spyod dngos grub dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā lā bhe tsa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ hūm̐/ ngo mtshar= shes rab ral gri'i= /nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas bcad// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i= khaḍ+ga= hūm̐/ ngo mtshar= bhan+dha thod pa'i= thugs rje zhi bas bdud bzhi bcom// byang chub sems kyi= ka pā (522)la= hūm̐/ ngo mtshar= /rtse gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ= /sku gsung thugs dang ldan gyur te// sku gsum yon tan tri shū la/ phrin las kyi dbang ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi// sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// zhi rgyas dbang drag mthu brnyes nas// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la sarba karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de nas phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo gong dang 'dra ba las brgyud pa/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ lcam legs smin/ klu'i bu thub pa mo/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ slob dpon rta dbyangs/ dus 'khor zhabs/ a bha yā ka ra/ tsā mi sangs rgyas grags/ rgwa lo gzhon nu dpal/ 'gro mgon zhang tshal pa nas rim par byon pa'i rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma sogs bsgyur/ mgon po sgrub par 'dod pa yin na sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin te snga ma ltar bya/ rjes dam tshig bsgrag bzung sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ yang brgyud lugs gnyis car gcig tu dril ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur khyad par can ni/ mgon po gtso rgyang nyid dam/ 'khor bcas ltar na/ bya rog gdong can gsum dang*/ mkha' 'gro brgyad kho nas bskor bar bya/ gsol gdab ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gtso// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ mthu stobs phrin las gcig bsdus pa// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// dngos grub bdag gis thob par shog

/ces pas byed cing*/ bla ma dang mgon po'i gnas lnga nas mgon po rigs lnga rim pas spros te slob ma'i gnas lngar rim pas thim tshul re re bzhin phog pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang lnga thob par bsam/ /de nas gtor dbang spyi dang 'dra ba las mthar (523)lha mo brgyad kyi thugs ka nas bya rog gdong can dpag tu med pas sa dang bar snang khengs pa tsam byon/ lha mo brgyad dang*/ de rnams thams cad ba spu'i bu ga nas thim/ gu ṇa hṛ da'i sngags drag tu bzla ba dang*// bya rog gdong can nyid kyi bka' bsgo bya// slar slob ma slar bskyed nas bzlas lung sbyin/ 'di khrid dang 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yin pas/ shin tu gces par bzung dgos zhes bla mas gsung la/ shin tu byin rlabs che bar myong bas kyang grub bo// bstan srung kun las ches mchog tu// rab tu grags shing dga' bar bsngags// gang de'i sgrub thabs snying po ni// rjes gnang lag len dang bcas mtshar// ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa rgwa lo lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// maṅga laṃ/ zhes sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las khol du phyungs rjes gnang nag 'gro sa kha gsal du byas pa dge legs 'phel/ /shubhaṃ// (524)
